name: FM Growl In Dub Space
desc: FUSES electro's FM growl bass (bass.electro.fm_growl) with dub-techno space (bass.dubtech.sine_sub's world): G#-minor growls hit the electro grid dry, then every fourth cycle gets thrown into a feedback delay that echoes across the bar.

code.full: note("<[g#1 ~ ~ g#1 ~ ~ b1 ~] [g#1 ~ ~ g#1 ~ ~ ~ f#1] [g#1 ~ g#1 ~ ~ b1 ~ ~] [c#2 ~ ~ b1 ~ g#1 ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${growl}).fmh(1.99).fmattack(.001).fmdecay(.12).attack(.003).decay(.32).sustain(.25).release(.08).lpf(1400).shape(.45).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).every(4, x=>x.delay(.5).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.5)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[g#1 ~ g#1 g#1 ~ b1 ~ f#1] [c#2 ~ b1 g#1 ~ g#1 b1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).superimpose(x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.4)).s("sine").fm(${growl}*1.4).fmh(1.99).fmattack(.001).fmdecay(.1).attack(.002).decay(.28).sustain(.25).release(.06).lpf(1800).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72,${gain}).fast(4)).every(2, x=>x.delay(.45).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.55)).orbit(3).play()
